annotations.annotation_text: Tavern/jury motif "bottle" on page 445 ("Jaun's Sermon"): the twelve customers drinking in HCE's Chapelizod pub represent public opinion, the Zodiac, and the Apostles within Jaun (Shaun) preaching to the twenty-nine girls, the Ondt and the Gracehoper fable, departure and farewell. During this Age of Men phase, they judge, condemn, and demand another round — the Greek chorus of middle-class Dublin gossip.
sources: Glasheen, Adaline. Third Census of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/thirdcensusoffin0000glas
Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp
Gordon, John. Finnegans Blog (Tavern chapters). https://johngordonfinnegan.weebly.com

annotations.annotation_text: Oneiric dimension "sleep" on page 445 ("Jaun's Sermon"): the nocturnal consciousness surfaces within Jaun (Shaun) preaching to the twenty-nine girls, the Ondt and the Gracehoper fable, departure and farewell. During this Age of Men phase, Joyce reconstructs the sleeping body's sensory deprivation — dimmed sight, distorted hearing, dream-logic association — transforming somatic experience into polyphonic language.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Freud, Sigmund. The Interpretation of Dreams. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4349
Troy, Mark L. Mummeries of Resurrection. http://www.rosenlake.net
